request.initial_prompt: Cleopatra. O well-divided disposition!—Note him, Note him, good Charmian, 'tis the man; but note him: He was not sad, for he would shine on those That make their looks by his; he was not merry, Which seemed to tell them his remembrance lay In Egypt with his joy; but between both. O heavenly mingle!—Be'st thou sad or merry, The violence of either thee becomes, So does it no man else.—Met'st thou my posts?
